finding.topology: The same repository is externally bound to one Cloudflare Pages project plus two Worker service names that differ only by singular/plural: fenix-capital-inmo-map and fenix-capital-inmo-maps.
finding.reason_root_cause_not_confirmed: GitHub exposes check names and Cloudflare dashboard targets but not the Cloudflare project/build configuration or logs required to establish ownership/configuration causality. No eligible Cloudflare control-plane connector is currently available.

safe_resolution: Do not change application code to chase an external failure that predates Factory.
Obtain Cloudflare control-plane access or equivalent read-only configuration evidence.
Identify the canonical Pages/Workers target and whether the singular/plural Worker bindings are both intended.
Reconcile only in a reversible non-PROD path, then compare OLD vs NEW before changing any production binding.
